evidence_candidates.excerpt: The authors describe HeteroBox, an FPGA-based platform that configures multiple memory regions with different host-access latency and bandwidth, and argue that NUMA emulation and full-system simulation alone have limitations for evaluating hardware-managed tiering at scale.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: A 2025 preprint proposes FPGA-based configurable latency and bandwidth regions for CXL tiering evaluation and identifies fidelity and scale limitations in simulation-only evaluation.
